[[File:Bucket of milk detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''bucket of milk''' is a [[Cooking]] ingredient used to make a variety of drinks and foods such as [[choc saturday]]s and [[cake]]s, as well as several [[pet feeder space|feeders]]. Players can use a [[bucket]] on a [[dairy cow]] or [[dairy buffalo]] to create a bucket of milk, or simply click on the cow or buffalo with at least one empty bucket in the [[inventory]].

Players can turn a bucket of milk into [[chocolatey milk]] by adding [[chocolate dust]], or add milk to [[nettle tea]] (though this does not add any effects). Depending on their Cooking level, [[Members]] can use a [[dairy churn]] to turn a bucket of milk into a [[pot of cream]], a [[pat of butter]], or a piece of [[cheese]].

A bucket of milk is required to complete the [[quests]] [[Cook's Assistant]], [[Gertrude's Cat]], [[Plague City]] (to make a [[Hangover cure]]), and the [[Skippy and the Mogres]] [[Miniquests|miniquest]] (to make a hangover cure).

This, alongside the [[chocolatey milk]], [[milky mixture]], and [[hangover cure]], can be stored in a [[bottomless milk bucket]]. Each bottomless milk bucket can only store one type of dairy product at a time.

==Uses==
===Quests===
*[[Cook's Assistant]]: 1 × bucket of milk
*[[Plague City]]: 1 × bucket of milk to make [[chocolatey milk]]
*[[Gertrude's Cat]]: 1 × bucket of milk
*[[Ghosts Ahoy]]: 1 × bucket of milk
*[[A Tail of Two Cats]]: 1 × bucket of milk
*[[Ratcatchers]]: 1 × bucket of milk
*[[Recipe for Disaster]] ([[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf|Freeing the Mountain Dwarf]] subquest): 1 × bucket of milk

===Miniquests===
*[[Skippy and the Mogres]]: 1 × bucket of milk to make chocolatey milk

===Pets===
A bucket of milk can also be used to feed kittens. If fed to a [[hellcat]], it will turn back into a normal [[cat]].
